hooks.name: Zero Raw JSX / Unsafe HTML Injection Guard
hooks.description: Asks the agent to audit saved TypeScript/React files for raw HTML/JSX evaluation that bypasses the @json-render Spec pipeline (Invariant 1).

action.prompt: Audit the saved file against Invariant 1 (No-JSX / No-HTML Law in .kiro/steering/genui-invariants.md). Confirm that dangerouslySetInnerHTML, eval(), new Function(), innerHTML/outerHTML assignment, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write and unvalidated raw HTML strings are not used, and that all dynamic UI rendering flows through @json-render Spec validation. `pnpm -r lint` enforces the same rules statically.
